{{Quote|I would have taken pleasure in meeting with Dathka Graush, who died decades before our arrival. Though he is gone, it was he who melded alchemy and spellcasting to perfect necromancy.|[[Sorzus Syn]], extract from [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|Chronicle of Sorzus Syn]]|<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />}}
'''Sith necromancy''' was a niche sub-discipline of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] combining the techniques and practices of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] with the rituals and incantations of Sith magic for the purposes of reanimating the dead.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />

[[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]], a [[Sith King]]<ref name="BoS:SftDS" /><ref name="SOM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="POLS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban|text=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|int=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls}}</ref> active in the decades prior to<ref name="TEAdate">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' says that Dathka Graush initiated his war in [[7000 BBY]] and [[Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls]] says that he was assassinated "after fifty years of bloodshed".</ref> the arrival of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]] in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="JvS:TEGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> was among the earliest practitioners of Sith necromancy,<ref name="BoS:SftDS" /> reanimating and commanding vast armies of [[Korriban zombie]]s<ref name="TCSWEIIKZ">{{CSWECite|II|227|Korriban zombie}}</ref> by means of the ''[[Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut]]'' incantation. The ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] included a copy the ''Tsaiwinokka Hoyakut'' spell in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]], expressing disappointment at being unable to meet the late Sith king prior to his death in the decades preceding the Exiles' arrival.<ref name="BoS:SftDS" />
